---
title: "Contact"
---

<section class="newsletter">
    <div class="about-container" style="display: block; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3rem;">
        <h2>Restons en contact</h2>
        <p>Pour toute demande professionnelle, dédicace, ou simplement pour dire bonjour.</p>
    </div>

    <form class="newsletter-form" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 500px; margin: 0 auto; gap: 1.5rem;">
        <input type="text" placeholder="Votre Nom" required style="width: 100%;">
        <input type="email" placeholder="Votre Email" required style="width: 100%;">
        <textarea placeholder="Votre Message" rows="5" style="width: 100%; padding: 0.8rem; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 16px; font-family: inherit;"></textarea>
        <button type="submit" class="btn-primary">Envoyer le message</button>
    </form>
    
    <div style="margin-top: 4rem;">
        <h3>Suivez-moi</h3>
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; font-size: 1.5rem;">
            <a href="#" style="color: var(--text-muted);"><i class="bi bi-instagram"></i></a>
            <a href="#" style="color: var(--text-muted);"><i class="bi bi-facebook"></i></a>
            <a href="#" style="color: var(--text-muted);"><i class="bi bi-twitter-x"></i></a>
        </div>
    </div>
</section>
